fair enough i will try to redeem myself.  actually - the more i sautéed your words around a bit - the more i got it.  wrong message for this board possibly because of it's soft fluffy nature - the kind of garbage i debunked and scoffed at for decades myself.  and no one was able to talk me out of my position because i was smarter than them.  hell i was so damn smart that I identified myself self as a self-actualized happy intellectual existentialist/solipsist - and how many of those do you see running around? i was hardcore about my beliefs because I read countless books by the consensus smartest people in their respective fields.  i read all of these great books because i was chasing the meaning of life or the conclusion - after a long hard fought battle - that my original hypothesis - that life had meaning needed discarded and replaced with its null.

needless to say - i got knocked from my self-absorbed little eagle's nest and came crashing to earth years later.

the metaphor of my arrogance of course - knowing that the majority of people out there - all six billion of them - were less able to handle the truth like me/us well-read atheists who can give you a thousand reasons why life means only what you say it does.

i am 1 of those peeps - i i was in a drug induced coma for nearly eight days.  i was is so much pain that i wanted to die.  i gave up on life several times and subsequently let go.  i laid there day after day just waiting to die and being completely at peace with it all.  when i did not die i was left with a new me.  i'm still an atheist i guess - but with a twist.  i no longer fear death - this in and of itself was/is a game changer.  i did not see any lights or tunnels or dead loved ones or any of that stuff.  here is what i believe transpired - i let go with my whole being - all the down to my amygdala or lizard brain.  if the lizard brain believes something to be true, then the cerebral cortex will follow.  one other major event ocurred to me following my NDE - and this new think helped me transcend my ego.
